Subject Request by the Japanese Military Police for information regarding
the Liang You Printing & Publishing Company
Made by D.S. Larby Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached Special Branch Report,
dated 6-4-37, requesting on behalf of the Japanese Military
Police, information regarding the undermentioned concern :
Liang You Printing & Publishing Company, 851 North
Szechuen Road, some details are submitted herewith.
The Liang You Printing and Publishing Company was
first established in 1925 with an issued capital of $75,000,
for which sum, one Chen Chah-sing (陳信) has been
largely responsible. Diligent enquiries made by members of
the Special Branch have failed to indicate that either the
above named person or the present manager of the company,
one Yue Hou-shang (余漢生) are in any way sympathizers
with the Soviet Regime or connected with any organization
which derives assistance, monetary or otherwise, from the
U.S.S.R.
It is of interest, however, to note that during the
latter part of 1933, the company in question was subjected
to a series of threatening letters purporting to emanate
from a body known as the "Shanghai Cinema Circles Communist
Extermination Association." These communications consisted
of a series of letters warning the company to cease printing
and, or, publishing any literature of a radical or
reactionary nature, citing as examples works of well known
Chinese "red" authors.
On the 12-11-33, one of the shop's plate glass windows
was smashed by some unknown person or persons and a number of
pamphlets bearing a slogan printed in Chinese were scattered
in the entrance way of the establishment. The translation of
the slogan reads as follows :-

由 D.S. Larby 制作 转交者 [签名]

兹参照附上的特别支部报告（日期为1937年4月6日），该报告代表日本宪兵队请求提供关于下述商号的信息：
良友图书印刷公司，北四川路851号，现提交一些细节如下。
良友图书印刷公司于1925年首次成立，发行资本为75,000元，陈信（Chen Chah-sing）对此负主要责任。特别支部成员进行的详尽调查未能表明上述人员或该公司现任经理余汉生（Yue Hou-shang）在任何方面同情苏维埃政权，或与任何从苏联获得金钱或其他援助的组织有联系。
然而，值得注意的是，在1933年下半年，该公司遭受了一系列恐吓信，声称来自一个名为“上海电影界铲共大同盟”的团体。这些信件是一系列警告，要求该公司停止印刷和/或出版任何具有激进或反动性质的文学作品，并举例引用了著名的中国“红色”作家的作品。
1933年11月12日，店铺的一块平板玻璃窗被不明身份者砸碎，入口处散落着许多印有中文标语的小册子。该标语的译文如下：-

也包括女诗人。题为《第二道防线》的文章中的以下段落值得关注：-
（第60页）：“当吴县长听到日军正向昆山县城东门进发的谣言时，他并未费心去核实谣言的真伪，便与其他几人一同逃走了。”
“听说县长已逃走，百姓惊慌失措，携带家眷财物离开该地。几乎整座城池空无一人。”
“当吴县长得知谣言纯属子虚乌有时，他觉得已不宜返回岗位。他在一条小溪中投水自尽。”
“如此无用的懦夫！怎配担任县长！”
“墙上写有许多标语。以下标语值得注意：-
1. 振奋精神，与倭寇进行肉搏战！
2. 洒热血，以争民族光荣！
3. 消灭嗜杀成性、纵火残忍、毫无人性的日本魔鬼！
4. 国破家何在！
切勿逃离城市！

As far as can be judged from the meagre information
in this catalogue, the remaining publications appear to be
of no particular interest and consist of the usual text
books, histories and general fiction. X
Assiduous enquiries by Special Branch detectives have
failed to bring to light any evidence to show that the Liang
You Printing and Publishing Company is remotely connected with
any organization which is in sympathy with the present Soviet
regime.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
S. I. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date April 6, 1937.
Subject Information regarding the Liang You Printing Co. and the International Correspondence School requested by the Japanese Military Police.
Made by I. Yamashita Forwarded by W. R. Farrier D/I

Mr. Nagasawa of the Japanese Military Police, whose office is at 1147 Dixwell Road, came to my office on the morning of April 6, and stated that he would be greatly obliged if the Municipal Police would furnish him with the following information regarding the Liang You Printing Co. (良友圖書公司), 50 North Honan Road, and the International Correspondence School (萬國函授學堂, 23 Nanking Road, i.e.:
1. Owner and operator.
2. The amount of capital invested and its source.
3. Date of establishment of the business.
4. A list of books published and the number of each publication in circulation.
5. If the business is in any way connected with the U.S.S.R. or any organ controlled by the U.S.S.R.
I was unable to obtain any idea regarding Mr. Nagasawa's reasons for desiring the above information.

S.I.
Yamashita
J.B.R.
6/4
D. Kamoshita
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

D. S. Lacey
J.L.T.

档案号 ............
S.I. 政治部分局，
报告
日期 1937年4月6日。
主题 关于应日本宪兵队要求提供良友图书公司及万国函授学校信息的报告。
制作人 I. Yamashita 转呈人 W. R. Farrier 副督察/督察长

日本宪兵队的长泽（Nagasawa）先生，其办公室位于狄思威路1147号，于4月6日上午来到我的办公室，并表示如果工部局警务处能提供以下关于河南北路50号良友图书公司（良友圖書公司）和南京路23号万国函授学校（萬國函授學堂）的信息，他将不胜感激，即：
1. 所有者及经营者。
2. 投资资本数额及其来源。
3. 业务成立日期。
4. 出版书籍清单及各出版物的发行数量。
5. 该业务是否与苏联或以苏联控制的任何机构有任何关联。
我未能获悉长泽先生希望获取上述信息的任何原因。

S.I.
Yamashita
J.B.R.
6/4
D. Kamoshita
副督察

警司（政治部）。

D. S. Lacey
J.L.T.
